purpose: Teach: 差額/草案/均一/雇っ/宛て/簿記/終身/巻き込ん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、予算と実績の差額、しっかり、把握する習慣、つけろ、研究にも、活きるぞ。
lines.en: Ren — get into the habit of keeping a close eye on the gap between budget and actual figures. That discipline will serve your research too.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Opens with the name as an anchor. Even pacing, no hurry. The tone of someone who has seen this matter before and wants it to stick. Clinical but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の草案、先生に、レビュー、お願いしてまいります、来週中に。
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask my professor to review the paper draft and get it to you by next week.
lines.style: Respectful and careful. Slight formality in the verb choice — not performing, just appropriate. Speaks with slight tension, the kind that comes from wanting to do this right. Ends on a note of quiet commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実験条件、均一に、保つこと、研究の基本だ、忘れずに、丁寧に、扱え。
lines.en: Keeping your experimental conditions uniform — that's the foundation of research. Don't let yourself forget that. Handle it with precision.
lines.style: Firmer now. Weight on the fundamental principle. Not lecturing, but making sure he hears the core. Tempo steady and deliberate. The voice of someone who has seen sloppy work derail careers.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究助手、二名、雇って、データ収集、進めております、効率化、図れています。
lines.en: Yes. I've hired two research assistants and we're making good progress on data collection. We're getting more efficient.
lines.style: Earnest but not urgent. A little lift of quiet pride in the middle — showing progress without overstatement. Measured pace. He's reporting in, not boasting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の宛て先、ジャーナル、慎重に、選ぶこと、評価に、直結する、覚えておけ。
lines.en: The journal you submit to matters more than you might think. Choose carefully — your choice will directly affect how your work is received. Remember that.
lines.style: Deliberate emphasis on the stakes. Not alarming, but serious. Pauses slightly before 'directly' to let the weight land. This is the voice of someone who knows what poor journal choices have cost other researchers.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の簿記、私自身、勉強しております、研究者として、必要な知識ですから。
lines.en: Yes. I'm teaching myself research accounting and bookkeeping on my own time. It's knowledge I need to have as a researcher.
lines.style: Quiet determination underneath. Not seeking praise — just stating fact. A slight firmness on 'need to have,' as though he's made this decision and isn't second-guessing it. Thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 終身の研究テーマ、若いうちに、見つけられると、いいな、君も、慎重に、選べ。
lines.en: It's a good thing to find your lifelong research question while you're still young. Give yourself permission to choose thoughtfully.
lines.style: Gentler than before. Almost reflective. Opens with a quiet hope, not a demand. The rhythm is slower here, more philosophical. This is advice earned from years, being offered without pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究者を、巻き込んで、新しい視点、取り入れたいです、これから、特に。
lines.en: Yes. I want to bring in collaborators and bring fresh perspectives into what we're doing. I think that's especially important going forward.
lines.style: Thoughtful and forward-looking. Opens softly, then gains a little momentum on 'fresh perspectives.' Not tentative — he's thought about this. Ends with quiet conviction about the direction, not seeking approval.
